__opsmind_meta.rollback: git revert <sha>; re-run grafana provisioning (recreate grafana)

panels.title: Liveness — is the relay running and connected? (SPEC-XREL-001 §Observability)
Pump-loop poll rate
panels.description: event_relay:poll:rate5m — the consume + reconnect loops tick this every ~5s regardless of traffic. Flat 0 for 5m fires EventRelayStalled (the process is down or wedged).

panels.title: Broker error rate
panels.description: event_relay:broker_errors:rate5m — the relay is up but its AMQP connection keeps failing. > 0 for 5m fires EventRelayBrokerUnreachable (warning). The poll rate stays non-zero in this state — that is how EventRelayStalled and EventRelayBrokerUnreachable are told apart.

panels.title: DLQ rate (all reasons)
panels.description: event_relay:dlq:rate5m — messages the relay dead-lettered to opsmind.dlx. Any non-zero value is a relay transform bug or a genuinely broken downstream contract, never normal. > 0 for 10m fires EventRelayDeadLettering (critical).

panels.title: Settlement rate by outcome
panels.description: event_relay:messages_by_outcome:rate5m. outcome ∈ ack | retry | dlq | no_delivery | poison. Steady 'ack' with occasional 'no_delivery' (an event with no linkage id — expected) is healthy; sustained 'retry' means a downstream service is unhealthy.

panels.title: Consume rate by event type
panels.description: sum by (event_type) rate(event_relay_messages_total). The 8 bridged routing keys: approval.{granted,denied,expired}.v1, improvement.promoted.v1, ticket.{resolved,closed}.v1, workflow.{completed,failed}.v1.

panels.title: Fan-out to the Python HTTP event seams
Delivery rate by target & outcome
panels.description: event_relay:deliveries_by_target_outcome:rate5m — one HTTP POST per delivery. target ∈ agent-runtime | tool-gateway | memory-knowledge. A 404/409/410 from a target that already moved on classifies as 'ack' (not an error).

panels.title: Delivery ack ratio by target
panels.description: Fraction of deliveries to each target that settled as ack over the last 5m. A sustained dip means that downstream service is returning 5xx / timing out and the relay is retrying.

panels.title: DLQ rate by reason
panels.description: sum by (reason) rate(event_relay_dlq_total). reason ∈ poison_envelope (an unparseable message on opsmind.events) | delivery_rejected (a downstream returned 400 / a permanent 4xx to a transformed body — a relay bug). Backs EventRelayDeadLettering.

panels.title: DLQ messages (cumulative, since relay start)
panels.description: sum(event_relay_dlq_total) by reason. Anything above 0 means at least one message has been dropped to opsmind.dlx — inspect event-relay.python-fanout.dlq.v1 (runbook).
